question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. 'encompasses.'

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of the words given in the options: 

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 likes
 to enjoy or approve of something or someone. (किसी चीज या किसी का आनंद लेना या उसका अनुमोदन करना)
 
 

 releases
 to give freedom or free movement to someone or something. (किसी को या किसी चीज़ को आज़ादी देना)
 
 

 makes
 to produce something, often using a particular substance or material. (कुछ उत्पादन करने के लिए, अक्सर किसी विशेष पदार्थ या सामग्री का उपयोग करना)
 
 

 encompasses
 to include different types of things. (विभिन्न प्रकार की चीजों को शामिल करना)
 
 
 
 

 

 
• Let's look at the sentence: " Education **____________*** both the teaching and learning of knowledge, proper conduct, and technical competency."
 
• We can say that the implied meaning of the sentence is **education includes** both the teaching and learning of knowledge, appropriate behaviour, and technical competency.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is "encompasses" to make the sentence meaningfully correct.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.

​

Complete passage:__ Education ***(1) __encompasses__*** both the teaching and learning of knowledge, proper conduct, and technical competency. It thus ***(2) __focuses__*** on the cultivation of skills, trades or professions, as well as mental, moral and aesthetic development. Formal education consists of systematic instruction, teaching and training by ***(3) __professional__*** teachers. This consists of the application of pedagogy and the development of curricula. The right to education is a ***(4) __fundamental__*** human right. Educational systems are established to provide education and ***(5) __training__*** often for children and the young.
